summary: The owned CLI adds init and ui.config.json, installs without shadcn configuration, and retains existing shadcn aliases for gradual adoption. A compiled, dependency-free tarball is built into the site preview and tested through npm exec in a fresh app, including transitive files, locks, sync and local edit preservation. Hosted registry indexes are read beside their items with a fallback for the GitHub mirror. Installation presents the owned preview first and shadcn as an alternative. Npm publication remains pending.
